title: Magnetic inelastic dark matter (MiDM) at LZ: the transition-dipole scattering spectrum, the de-excitation photon and the surviving parameter space
question: If the LZ event is MiDM (Majorana pair split by delta with a transition magnetic moment mu_chi) at 1 TeV: what is the xenon spectrum and its dipole-charge vs dipole-dipole decomposition, where does 248 keV sit, does the 1/q^2 charge term repopulate the low-energy window, what mu_chi gives one event, what tau(delta) and P(clean) follow, what do elastic and low-energy data constrain, what relic density does chi1 chi2 -> f fbar give, is there an astrophysical 300 keV line, and how do W and I rates scale relative to Xe?
headline_result: In MiDM the LZ event is a dipole-dipole (spin) scatter: the Z^2 charge term is 0.6-0.9% of the 248 keV rate at every delta, so there is no low-energy tail (window empty for delta > 246 keV) and P012's elastic exclusion does not apply; one event needs mu_chi = 2.19e-4 mu_N at delta = 300 keV (annual 2.108e-4, P023 2.107e-4); tau(delta) with P042's P(clean|tau) excludes delta > 355 keV at 90% (P(clean) = 0.9/0.5/0.1 at 321/342/355 keV); <sigma v>(chi1 chi2 -> f fbar) = alpha mu^2 sum N_c Q_f^2 gives Omega h^2 = 6.2 (52x over-abundant) and the thermal moment 1.57e-3 mu_N fits only at delta = 351 keV where P(clean) = 0.15; MiDM predicts I/Xe = 12.4 and W/Xe = 0.13 at 300 keV, the reverse of O1
model_or_mechanism: MiDM: photon-coupled transition magnetic dipole in NREFT (c1, c5 ~ 1/q^2 dipole-charge; c4, c6 dipole-dipole; P012/P023 coefficients) with WimPyDD inelastic kinematics on Xe/W/I; Gamma = mu^2 delta^3/pi with P042 P(clean|tau); s-channel-photon annihilation chi1 chi2 -> f fbar derived at threshold
result_type: computed (spectra, moments, lifetimes, ratios) / estimated (relic normalisation, loop and line estimates)
confidence: medium - rates cross-checked against P023/P012/P002/P046 to <= 4%, but NREFT coefficients, Gamma and the thermal target are recalled formulae; W spin response is a WimPyDD placeholder
agent_tools: Read x17, Bash x19, Write x4, Edit x20
software_and_packages: python 3.12.13; WimPyDD 2.0.4 (eft_hamiltonian q/mchi closures, diff_rate with delta, Xe/W/I targets); numpy 2.5.3; scipy 1.18.1; pandas 3.0.5; matplotlib 3.11.2; common/lzcommon.py
